change.geometry: 32 local384 workgroups; four owners per KV head partition its nine query heads as 2+2+2+3
change.control_geometry: 24 local384 workgroups; three GQA3 owners per KV head
change.mechanism: raise ordinary-workgroup breadth without leaving the fused QK/softmax/PV phase; two-head owners keep four waves barrier-active but arithmetic-idle during staged PV
change.arithmetic: exact retained QK tree, maximum, compiler expf with proven non-positive domain, denominator, PV FMA, divide, gate, and stores

correctness.repair: keep all local384 threads in the block-uniform staged-V barriers while guarding arithmetic and output stores with active_output
